Design authority: docs/delivery/workspace-design.md, sections 3.1, 8.1; courts A/J. Visual references: mockups/workspace-vision-2026-09-22/README.md.
Repository owner: storyatlas4s. Delivery boundary: M1 implementation.
Integration parent: bd-01M34JJ6YR2K714HPAPT8YTES6; parent relationship does not itself block execution.
Entry dependencies: bd-01M35A7ACS0A97QN5TF4F2QP3K.

REUSE, SCOPE AND PRESERVATION
Own Main/Open UI and local file adapters. Reuse checked import policy; accept supported workspace/source-only artifacts and existing Voyage documents through one dispatch route. No remote fetch or inference, handwritten fixture fallback, or story text in the shell.

ACCEPTANCE AND FAILURE WITNESSES
1. The same app.js opens WOG and second generated bundles, a lawful source-only artifact set and a legacy Voyage document.
2. Validate identities/roles/schema/bytes/permissions before atomic activation; cancel, error and older delayed completion leave the correct prior workspace labeled.
3. Wrong IDs with same title/local keys refuse; optional missing media/features stays useful; denied strings are absent from DOM/accessibility/tooltips/diagnostics.

EVIDENCE
Record exact producer/consumer/dependency revisions, fixture digests, actual commands/results and warnings/skips. Apply design section 11.5 and AGENTS.md to the changed runtime boundary, including compileAll testAll scalafmtCheckAll app/fastLinkJS and relevant existing/new browser courts for shell changes; use isolated siblings and session-owned project browsers. Documentation-only or human-study evidence is scoped as such. New test names are specifications until implemented and run. No inference, calibration, hosted CI, publication or release is certified by ticket creation.

FALLBACK
Existing embedded Voyage and fixture routes remain; disable only new Open if needed.

Coordinate one implementation writer and one heavy build at a time. Reserve exact paths when taking the ticket; do not claim other writers' scopes. Keep scientific operations in StoryModel, reuse this application and preserve unrelated edits.
set.title: [M1] Add atomic local Open for joined, source-only and legacy artifacts
